name: Easing
summary: Easing curves for animations, backed by a prebuilt C++ archive.
description: Interpolates between two values with linear, smoothstep, cubic in/out or back-out curves. The desktop build links lib/libeasing.a, which the IDE copies into the project and registers in [native] when the module is added. Removing the module deletes the copy and the entry again; HTML5 compiles the same curves directly.
author: GameBasiX
